title: Agreement under tape shifts
statement: Let $c$ and $c'$ be configurations of the same $k$-tape machine on the same input, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $d$ assign an integer shift to each tape. They agree under the shifts $d$ beyond distance $r$ when they have the same state, input-head position, and output; the head on tape $i$ in $c'$ is shifted by $d(i)$ from its position in $c$; and for every tape $i$ and every cell $z$ at or to the right of the head in $c$ minus $r$, the contents of cell $z+d(i)$ in $c'$ equal those of cell $z$ in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Two configurations of the same $k$-tape machine on the same input
